aortic dissection may be a cause of severe arterial hypertension in young adults, even in apparently healthy patients, and that the clinical presentation may be atypical.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the correct diagnosis of aortic dissections is not always easy, and that aortic dissection should always be considered when an acute abdominal process is suspected, even in patients who are not at high risk for aortic diseases.
